name: Alice Lee
title: About
text:
IllustrationMuralsCeramicsContentAboutShop
Hi, I'm Alice — I'm an independent illustrator and muralist based in San Francisco. ‍
‍
I want to create work with heart, purpose, and originality. Some of my favorite projects include hosting Doodle Therapy, my drawing show for Adobe Live, creating a series of dimensional woodcut mural installations (left), and spinning up my line of ceramics art collections inspired by my childhood memories growing up as an Asian-American kid in the Bay. And if you're in SF, you might've seen my murals around here for projects with National Geographic, the Asian Art Museum, Sunset Dunes, the NBA, Philz Coffee, Slack, SJ Walls, and more.
‍
Previously, I was an early product designer and second illustrator at Dropbox. Before that, I graduated from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School.

What I do
Murals
From woodcut 3D installations to the multi-story buildings, I'm always looking for beautiful, big walls to paint on! 

Illustration
Drawing and I have always been friends. I love creating warm, friendly artwork for brands, campaigns, and fun projects.

Ceramics
I create limited edition ceramic collections that's simply the art I wish to see in the world. I'd love to combine installation art with ceramics.

I put a lot of love into my Instagram. It's my art journal! →
